hero.headline: I turn early products into revenue.
hero.subline: 5+ years across fintech and SaaS. PKR 25 Cr+ in sales closed. Took AsaanBill from launch to $1.8M+ in monthly transaction volume.
hero.roleLine: Manager, Product & Growth at Evamp & Saanga

proof.nameStripTitle: Built at, backed by and recognised by

playbook.heading: How I grow products
playbook.intro: The same three stages, every time.

stages.name: Product-Idea Fit
stages.question: Is the problem worth solving, and for whom?
stages.proof: Led AsaanBill's 0→1 launch and pre-sold Tapit on a prototype.

stages.name: Product-Market Fit
stages.question: Will customers pay and come back?
stages.proof: Onboarded AsaanBill's first 50 business customers; took Tapit to 3,000+ customers.

stages.name: Scale
stages.question: Can it grow without breaking, and legally?
stages.proof: 15+ ERP partnerships, the Raast P2M go-to-market and $1.8M+ in monthly volume.

hardWins.heading: Things that aren't easy
hardWins.intro: Payments in Pakistan are regulated, gated and slow to open. These are the gates AsaanBill got through.

items.title: 1Bill aggregator approval
items.text: Through 1LINK, November 2024. Merchants' bills become payable in banking apps and at bank branches.

items.title: Raast approval
items.text: Through the State Bank, June 2026. Raast onboarding runs from application and integration through a pilot before going live.

items.title: Three ways to get paid
items.text: PSID-based payments, QR payments and Request to Pay.

items.title: SBP-reviewed onboarding
items.text: Every merchant integration passes a State Bank review before it goes live.
